summary: StableCoinX Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a restructuring of prior convertible promissory notes assumed from TLGY Acquisition Corporation's former SPAC sponsors. On August 21, 2026, the company entered into Note Consolidation and Restructuring Agreements with TLGY Sponsors LLC, CPC Sponsor Opportunities I, LP, and its parallel fund, covering roughly $6.9 million principal. Per terms, 5% is paid in cash, 47.5% in Tranche A warrants at $1.00 each (exercise $11.50), and 47.5% in Tranche B warrants at $0.75 each (exercise $15.00). This debt-to-equity-like swap reduces cash obligations. Watch for warrant issuance dilutive effects and sponsor alignment.
